Separating them needs the branching resampler inside this engine and vertical rate in the BFO model.

original_text: For the JON submission format the WORD RANGE BINDS, NOT THE PAGE COUNT. At single column, 12pt Times New Roman, 2·54cm margins, single line spacing and zero paragraph spacing, a page carries roughly 46 lines at about 12 words, so ~550 words; 20 pages is therefore about 11,000 words of unbroken text, and an 8,000-word paper with ten figures and three tables lands near 17 pages. This is estimated from the format specification, not from a compile (no TeX engine works in the sandbox) — treat ±2 pages as the uncertainty. original_text: Architecture's synthesis of the 00:19 question (18 Oct 2026), proposed to Pete as the paper's discussion framing: every datum except the 00:19:37 R1200 frequency read as a descent rate (00:11 handshake, R600 BTO+BFO as recorded, APU/SDU log-on timing, fuel-model flame-out median, right-then-left engine order, 18:25 R600 behaviour) is jointly satisfied by the plain ATSB sequence (normal configuration, second flame-out ~00:17:29, log-on +2 min, phugoid at the bursts). Admitting the R1200 forces three things at once: the alternate electrical configuration, an uncontrolled dive already 3.6–5 min old at the log-on, and 3.8–5.4 min of unexplained SDU power loss. The R1200 is therefore 'expensive' rather than contradicted; the posterior with it held out is the reference and the both-burst treatments are priced alternatives.

original_text: Punchline framing proposed for the paper's 00:19 discussion. Three independent lines of evidence each count against the alternate-configuration dive and cost little for the normal-configuration phugoid with the R1200 held out: (1) the log-on timing gate, (2) seabed-search non-detection near the arc, (3) Cape Leeuwin non-detection. Each is individually soft (a timing residual, a single detection rating q, a gated and under-powered acoustic term), but because they are independent their penalties add. Recommendation: keep the R1200-held-out posterior as the reference, present the both-burst treatments as alternatives with their combined price stated, and report the acoustic term as a 0 to about −1 nat sensitivity.
